con-trĕmo , ŭi, 3,
I.v. n., to tremble greatly, to quake (rare): caelum tonitru contremit, Pac. ap. Cic. de Or. 3, 39, 157 (Trag. Rel. v. 413 Rib.): “fulminis horribili cum plagā torrida tellus Contremit,” Lucr. 5, 1220 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
